variants.title: The Sinai Campaign (1956), fought without Britain and France
variants.note: Your cabinet declined Sevres: Israel fights in Sinai alone. With no Anglo-French landing at the Canal to draw off the Egyptian army and no ultimatum to time the second stage, every Sinai front is held more strongly and the four fronts are fought as one campaign.
